identity_and_mission.target_audience: Maritime Instructors, Ship Simulator Cadets, Bridge Operators
identity_and_mission.design_archetype: The Performance Pro / Tactical Maritime Instrument (High Precision, Zero Friction, Dark Night Console Aesthetic)
identity_and_mission.emotional_tone: Tactical, Mission-Critical, High-Precision, Ultra-Legible, Immersive Bridge Hardware Feel

color_system.palette_mode: Maritime Night Mode (Default) with optional Day/Dusk Color Modes
color_system.contrast_rules: Digital heading readout must be 100% pure white (#FFFFFF) or high-visibility tactical yellow/cyan with high contrast > 10:1 ratio against true black background.

font_families.digital_readout: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
font_families.body_text: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

scale.digital_heading_readout: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tighter
scale.digital_heading_tenths: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-mono font-light opacity-80
scale.labels_true: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase text-emerald-400 font-semibold

layout_and_architecture.structure: Single Screen 100vh 100vw Overflow-Hidden Bridge Display Container

compass_card_specs.responsive_sizing: w-[85vw] h-[85vw] max-w-[700px] max-h-[700px] sm:max-w-[800px] sm:max-h-[800px]
compass_card_specs.rotation: CSS transform rotate(-heading deg) smooth transition with anti-aliased SVG rendering
compass_card_specs.lubber_line: Fixed red vertical vector at 12 o'clock position (0° top relative to screen)
compass_card_specs.bezel: Outer metallic subtle bezel ring with precision millimeter notch markings

bearing_sight_mechanism.interaction: Click/Tap/Drag anywhere on compass rose, or use rotatable cursor handle to set bearing line
bearing_sight_mechanism.overlay_display: Displays True Bearing (TB) and Relative Bearing (RB) calculations in a floating tactical hud badge
bearing_sight_mechanism.controls: Dedicated quick reset bearing button, alignment lock, and quick degree offset buttons (+10°, -10°, +1°, -1°)

top_hud_bar.left_section: Transas NTPRO 5000 Gyro Repeater Status & Vessel Indicator
top_hud_bar.center_section: Rotatable digital readout with TRUE label & status LED
top_hud_bar.right_section: Fullscreen toggle, Sound Toggle, Bearing Line Toggle, Settings Gear Button

bottom_status_bar.nmea_sentence: Live raw $HEHDT sentence stream preview pill
bottom_status_bar.connection_pill: WebSocket Connection Status LED with stale data pulse indicator (>2s latency triggers amber glow)

shadcn_components_used: Dialog / Sheet for Settings Panel (UDP Port, WS Server URL, Simulator Speed, NMEA Generator)
Switch for Simulator Mode toggle, Dark/Night palette switch, Sound Click feedback
Slider for NMEA updates/sec, smooth damping animation speed, dimming/brightness level
Badge for NMEA status, active bearing modes, connection status
Tooltip for action icons (Fullscreen, Lock Bearing, Reset Bearing)

simulator_mock_generator.features: Built-in realistic ship turn dynamics simulator (port/starboard turn rates, course hold, sway noise) when WebSocket is disconnected, ensuring full offline demonstrability.

key_features: Precision 360° Rotating SVG Compass Rose with 1° minor ticks and 10° major ticks labeled
Centrally highlighted Digital Heading Readout with tenths precision (e.g., 278.5° TRUE)
Interactive Rotatable Bearing Line overlay calculating True Bearing & Relative Bearing
Real-time WebSocket NMEA 0183 $HEHDT parser with automatic fallback to Simulator Mode
Connection Health LED Indicator (Green = Active stream, Amber = Stale >2s, Red = Disconnected)
Dedicated Fullscreen Mode togglable via 'F' key press or HUD button
Keyboard Shortcuts (F: Fullscreen, B: Toggle Bearing Sight, R: Reset Bearing to 0°, S: Settings, Space: Pause Simulation)
Live Raw NMEA Log Monitor Drawer for maritime telemetry diagnostic
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements and readouts include the specified data-testid attributes.
The background must strictly adhere to full pitch black (#05070A) for a dedicated bridge instrument feel.
Implement smooth continuous gyro card rotation math avoiding full 360-to-0 degree snap glitches (use unwrapped angle interpolation).
Include both real WebSocket listener for Transas $HEHDT sentences AND built-in interactive simulator mode so user can test without external UDP source.
